examples: Several delinquent teenagers were sent to a special counseling program instead of jail.
چند نوجوان بزهکار به‌جای زندان به یک برنامه مشاوره ویژه فرستاده شدند.
The bank sent a notice about the delinquent account that had not been paid in months.
بانک اطلاعیه‌ای درباره حساب معوقه‌ای که ماه‌ها پرداخت نشده بود ارسال کرد.
Juvenile court judges try to understand why a young person became delinquent in the first place.
قضات دادگاه نوجوانان سعی می‌کنند بفهمند چرا یک نوجوان از ابتدا بزهکار شده است.
miniContext: Someone described as delinquent has broken rules or laws, often referring to young offenders who commit minor crimes. The term is also used for overdue payments, as in a delinquent loan that has not been paid on time. Social workers often look for the underlying causes before labeling a teenager delinquent.

examples: The referee decided to penalize the team for a dangerous tackle.
داور تصمیم گرفت تیم را به دلیل یک تکل خطرناک مجازات کند.
Schools should not penalize students for asking too many questions.
مدارس نباید دانش‌آموزان را به دلیل پرسیدن سؤالات زیاد مجازات کنند.
The new policy will penalize companies that fail to reduce their carbon emissions.
سیاست جدید شرکت‌هایی را که در کاهش انتشار کربن خود ناکام بمانند، مجازات خواهد کرد.
miniContext: To penalize someone means to punish them, usually for breaking a rule or falling short of a requirement. In sports, a referee can penalize a player with a yellow card for unsportsmanlike behavior. Governments sometimes penalize companies financially when they violate environmental or safety regulations.

examples: She felt teaching was her true vocation, not just a job to pay the bills.
او احساس می‌کرد تدریس واقعاً حرفه و رسالت اوست، نه فقط شغلی برای پرداخت هزینه‌ها.
Many nurses describe their work as a vocation rather than merely a career.
بسیاری از پرستاران کار خود را بیشتر یک رسالت می‌دانند تا صرفاً یک شغل.
Finding your true vocation sometimes takes years of trying different jobs.
پیدا کردن رسالت شغلی واقعی خودت گاهی سال‌ها طول می‌کشد و نیازمند آزمودن شغل‌های مختلف است.
miniContext: A vocation is a type of work that someone feels strongly called to do, often because it matches their deepest values rather than simply earning money. Religious life has traditionally been described as a vocation, but the word now applies to any meaningful career, such as medicine or social work. People who find their vocation often report greater satisfaction than those who merely have a job.

examples: The detective was assigned to investigate the homicide that occurred downtown last night.
کارآگاه برای بررسی قتلی که دیشب در مرکز شهر رخ داد منصوب شد.
The city's homicide rate dropped significantly after the new policing program began.
نرخ قتل در شهر بعد از شروع برنامه جدید پلیسی به‌طور قابل‌توجهی کاهش یافت.
The jury had to decide whether the shooting was self-defense or homicide.
هیئت منصفه باید تصمیم می‌گرفت که آن تیراندازی دفاع از خود بود یا قتل.
miniContext: Homicide is the legal term for the killing of one person by another. Police departments often have a special homicide unit dedicated to investigating murders and suspicious deaths. Not every homicide is treated the same way in court; the circumstances determine whether it is considered murder, manslaughter, or justified self-defense.

examples: The company has to acknowledge the mistake publicly or risk losing customer trust.
شرکت باید علناً اشتباه را بپذیرد، وگرنه خطر از دست دادن اعتماد مشتریان را به جان می‌خرد.
He refused to acknowledge that his plan had any flaws.
او حاضر نشد قبول کند که نقشه‌اش هیچ نقصی دارد.
Please acknowledge receipt of this email as soon as possible.
لطفاً دریافت این ایمیل را هرچه سریع‌تر تأیید کنید.
miniContext: To acknowledge something means to admit that it exists or is true, even when doing so is uncomfortable. A good leader will acknowledge their own mistakes instead of blaming the team. In formal writing, authors often acknowledge the people who helped with their research at the beginning of a book.

examples: The committee decided to reject the proposal because of its high cost.
کمیته تصمیم گرفت پیشنهاد را به دلیل هزینه بالای آن رد کند.
She had to reject three job offers before finally accepting one she liked.
او مجبور شد سه پیشنهاد شغلی را رد کند تا بالاخره یکی که دوستش داشت را بپذیرد.
The body can sometimes reject a transplanted organ even with the right medication.
بدن گاهی حتی با داروی مناسب می‌تواند یک عضو پیوندی را رد کند.
miniContext: To reject something means to refuse to accept, believe, or approve of it. Publishers reject the vast majority of manuscripts they receive, which can be discouraging for new writers. In medicine, a patient's immune system may reject an organ transplant if it recognizes the tissue as foreign.

examples: The prison warden announced new rules about visiting hours.
رئیس زندان قوانین جدیدی درباره ساعات ملاقات اعلام کرد.
As a game warden, she patrols the forest to protect wildlife from poachers.
او به‌عنوان نگهبان حیات‌وحش، برای محافظت از جانوران در برابر شکارچیان غیرقانونی در جنگل گشت می‌زند.
The traffic warden gave the car a ticket for parking in the wrong zone.
نگهبان ترافیک به آن خودرو به دلیل پارک در منطقه نادرست جریمه داد.
miniContext: A warden is a person responsible for supervising or protecting a particular place or group of people. A prison warden manages the daily operation of a correctional facility and is responsible for the safety of both staff and inmates. The same word also applies to a game warden who protects wildlife or a traffic warden who enforces parking rules.

examples: Each employee is allowed to add a spouse to the company health insurance plan.
هر کارمند اجازه دارد همسر خود را به طرح بیمه درمانی شرکت اضافه کند.
Before moving abroad, she discussed the decision carefully with her spouse.
قبل از مهاجرت به خارج، او این تصمیم را با همسرش به‌دقت در میان گذاشت.
In many cultures, choosing a spouse is still influenced by family opinion.
در بسیاری از فرهنگ‌ها، انتخاب همسر هنوز هم تحت تأثیر نظر خانواده است.
miniContext: A spouse is a husband or wife, the person someone is legally married to. Many immigration forms ask whether the applicant is bringing a spouse or children with them. Supporting a spouse through a difficult period, such as illness or job loss, is often considered an essential part of marriage.

examples: The old bridge was declared unstable after the earthquake and closed to traffic.
آن پل قدیمی بعد از زمین‌لرزه ناپایدار اعلام شد و به روی ترافیک بسته شد.
His mood has been unstable ever since he lost his job.
خلق‌وخوی او از زمانی که شغلش را از دست داد ناپایدار بوده است.
Investors are nervous because the regional currency remains unstable.
سرمایه‌گذاران نگران هستند چون ارز منطقه همچنان ناپایدار باقی مانده است.
miniContext: Something unstable is likely to change suddenly or collapse because it lacks a firm foundation. A government can become unstable when different political factions refuse to cooperate. In chemistry, an unstable compound may break down quickly or react violently when exposed to heat or light.

examples: The harsh sentence will deprive him of his freedom for the next ten years.
آن حکم سخت او را برای ده سال آینده از آزادی‌اش محروم خواهد کرد.
Staying up all night to study can deprive students of the sleep they desperately need.
بیدار ماندن تا صبح برای مطالعه می‌تواند دانش‌آموزان را از خوابی که شدیداً به آن نیاز دارند محروم کند.
The drought threatened to deprive the village of its main water supply.
خشکسالی تهدید می‌کرد که روستا را از منبع اصلی آبش محروم کند.
miniContext: To deprive someone of something means to take it away or prevent them from having it, often something essential. Solitary confinement is designed to deprive prisoners of social contact for long periods. Parents are generally advised never to deprive a growing child of proper nutrition, even as a form of punishment.

examples: The victim's family waited twenty years for justice to finally be served.
خانواده قربانی بیست سال منتظر ماندند تا عدالت سرانجام اجرا شود.
True justice requires that everyone, regardless of wealth, be treated equally under the law.
عدالت واقعی ایجاب می‌کند که همه، بدون توجه به ثروتشان، در برابر قانون یکسان رفتار شوند.
Many activists devote their lives to fighting for social justice.
بسیاری از فعالان زندگی خود را وقف مبارزه برای عدالت اجتماعی می‌کنند.
miniContext: Justice is the idea that people should be treated fairly and that wrongdoing should be punished appropriately. Courts exist to administer justice according to the law, though many people argue that the system does not always succeed. Beyond the legal system, the concept of justice also shapes debates about fairness in areas like wages, education, and healthcare.

examples: She named her daughter as the sole beneficiary of her life insurance policy.
او دخترش را به‌عنوان تنها ذی‌نفع بیمه عمر خود معرفی کرد.
Local farmers were the main beneficiaries of the new irrigation project.
کشاورزان محلی اصلی‌ترین بهره‌مندان از پروژه آبیاری جدید بودند.
As the main beneficiary of his uncle's will, he inherited the family house.
او به‌عنوان ذی‌نفع اصلی وصیت‌نامه عمویش، خانه خانوادگی را به ارث برد.
miniContext: A beneficiary is a person or group that receives money, property, or some other benefit, often as the result of a will, policy, or program. When someone buys life insurance, they must choose a beneficiary who will receive the payout after they die. Government aid programs are designed so that the intended beneficiaries actually receive the help they need.
